citation.title: Edge pedestal control in quiescent H-mode discharges in DIII-D using co-plus counter-neutral beam injection
citation.authors: K.H. Burrell, T.H. Osborne, P.B. Snyder, W.P. West, M.E. Fenstermacher, R.J. Groebner, P. Gohil, A.W. Leonard, W.M. Solomon

topic: Pedestal density, pressure and ELM-free state in DIII-D QH-mode as NBI torque and edge rotation are varied; peeling-ballooning (ELITE) stability context.
own_question: Can edge rotation, varied through co- and counter-NBI torque, control pedestal transport, and is QH-mode possible with edge co-rotation?
actual_method_and_evidence: Experimental DIII-D shot time histories and profiles. Torque scans were run at near-constant power, single-null and double-null shapes were compared, and ELITE/EFIT stability diagrams used Sauter bootstrap current. The paper reports pedestal density rising as torque falls, ELMs returning at low rotation, and co-rotating QH-mode. Interpretation of EHO transport is presented as speculation or semi-quantitative theory. No nowcasting, no KSTAR, no CES-report timing analysis.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: In DIII-D QH-mode, the authors report that changing NBI torque and edge rotation altered pedestal density and pressure while ELM-free operation was maintained, within limits.
claim_checks.qualification: Single-device experiments. The rotation-transport link is the authors' interpretation and was speculative regarding mechanism. It does not concern ion-temperature measurement or KSTAR.

input_target_timing_if_relevant: Not relevant. The paper does not study CES report timing or real-time estimation.
validation_if_relevant: Not applicable. There is no predictive model validation.
forbidden_inferences: That this paper informs CES Ti nowcasting performance or BES/ECEI incremental value
That pedestal rotation-transport coupling is established for KSTAR2022
That EHO theory is quantitatively validated
That this source's ion-temperature measurements are equivalent to our carbon-impurity CES labels
reason_to_include_or_exclude: Include only as optional background on why the pedestal-top ion state matters for pedestal physics. Otherwise it is off-topic for a causal-nowcasting study.
source_scope_note: All extracted page texts supplied; figure/equation visual validation remains separate
